# Hardware runs: PicoZed 7030 + FMC Carrier V2, 2026-10-26

Taken while working through `docs/BRINGUP_CHECKLIST.md` on the board (bitstreams from
`build.tcl` at commit 2f4a0fb, Vivado 2022.2). Every run below was checked against the
model with `model/compare.py` and passed. Each folder holds `config.csv`, `counters.csv`
and `hist_ch0..3.csv`; the table is generated from those files.

- Set 1 baseline: `run_20261026_112530`
- Set 2 baseline: `run_20261026_112742`
- Threshold 600 on ch3, then gain 4: `run_20261026_112820`, `run_20261026_112851`
- Coincidence sweep (4 patterns x 7 windows, 1 s each): `run_20261026_112958` .. `run_20261026_114300`
- ch3 threshold sweep (`daq.py sweep-threshold`): the `_th*` folders
